goal: Return error details directly up the call stack when fatal storage or validation errors occur
Allow kernel embedders and modular applications to inspect and handle failures without notification callbacks
agreement: Unaddressed objection: Result-style errors harm performance and violate C++ idioms (purpleKarrot)
Fragile nested result wrapping may cause call sites to miss interruption (maflcko)
Resolved concern: ignored flush return values mutating validation state (optout21)
Approval from an account with no project history and no stated reason (Graysonbarton)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it decouples validation error handling from node-specific shutdown routines
It directly helps kernel embedders manage fatal errors programmatically rather than via callbacks

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it extends the shared Result utility with structured failure types across subsystems
The utility improvements provide moderate leverage but are internally focused

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it propagates errors and enforces checks without altering validation rules or invariants
The impact within validation is primarily cleanup driven by kernel modularity goals
